demoGuide.claimsNavigation:
Use Overview for direct actions, Evidence for files and the policy, Analysis & facts for cover, fraud and Web IQ, Customer for editable drafts, and Weather & map for location and Aurora availability. The claim Timeline has a single main tab. More contains technical data.

In Weather & map, choose Aurora evidence, Loss location or Web IQ sources; only the active panel is shown. In Aurora, choose Hourly chart, Claim timing, Provenance or Case actions. Playback is manual. Overview and Ask IQ read saved evidence only for its displayed window, even while new calculations are unavailable. Selecting a tab does not run Aurora or Web IQ.
demoGuide.title: Demo Guide
demoGuide.subtitle: Demo for {company} — {scenario}

habitation.label: Property Claims
habitation.summary:
Olivier MERTENS LAFFITE (mlo@wine.com) — Storm Gérard 03/27/2026 — Flooded cellar, wine collection destroyed — €10,825
File E0FF1B47 — 4 photos + 1 PDF (insurer claim form)

steps.title: 1. Select "Property Claims"
steps.detail: Top persona selector → "Claims" group → "Property Claims" (cloud/rain line icon).
steps.tip: Accepts PDF + images. RAG searches the indexed habitation policy terms.

steps.title: 2. Upload documents
steps.detail:
• declaration-sinistre-habitation.pdf (insurer claim form)
• 4 photos of flooded cellar, damaged walls, broken bottles (PNG/JPG)

Use "New Application" or drag and drop the files into the dashboard drop zone: processing starts automatically.
steps.tip: PDF is in assets/demo-prevaiq/property-claims/wine-cellar/.

steps.title: 3. Watch AI processing (2-3 min)
steps.detail:
① Extraction engine → Content Understanding / MarkItDown structures fields and attachments
② Multimodal analysis → qualifies damage photos
③ LLM analysis + RAG → evaluates the claim and cites applicable policy terms

The "AI pipeline" pill next to the case title shows how the case was read: green OK, amber review needed, red problem. Click it for engines, model and budget.

steps.title: 4. Weather, Anti-Fraud & Cat-Nat Analysis
steps.detail:
Open Weather & map for location and Aurora availability. Only run Aurora when available; without a completed forecast, no weather chart is shown. Historical initial conditions are not live observations.

From Overview, Run fraud analysis starts the check directly. If a result exists, open the report in Analysis & facts; rerunning is a separate action. Web IQ runs with fraud analysis and checks French Cat-Nat and public sources where relevant. Needs your attention lists each signal once.
steps.tip: Aurora evidence is predictive and advisory; Web IQ sources remain clickable historical evidence.

steps.title: 5. Ask IQ (RAG Chat)
steps.detail:
Ask IQ button in the bottom-right of the workbench. Suggested questions:

→ "Is this claim covered by the Housing policy?"
→ "What is the storm deductible?"
→ "Are wines in a cellar considered valuables?"
steps.tip: Click "X policies referenced" to see cited articles.

steps.title: 6. Adjuster decision
steps.detail: The verdict bar shows the AI recommendation and why. Record a decision opens a pre-filled draft; Other decision offers Approve (green), Approve with conditions (amber), Defer (grey) or Decline (red). Review evidence, conditions and notes before confirming. The decision remains human.

habitation-ch.label: Property Claims (CH)
habitation-ch.summary:
Schoggimanufaktur Eulachblick GmbH (fictitious) — Hailstorm in Winterthur 08/28/2026 — Shop, workshop and cold room damaged — CHF 1,697,400 claimed
German claim form + German and English e-mails + 6 AI photos (MAI-Image-2.6) — 3 points to check: GVZ building, refrigerated goods, photo taken before the storm

steps.title: 1. Select "Property Claims"
steps.detail: Same persona as the French home claims: the jurisdiction (Switzerland, CHF, German sources) is detected from the documents.
steps.tip: Real demo map anchor: Steinberggasse 23, 8400 Winterthur. The business, premises and loss are fictional; AI photos do not depict the actual building or occupants. Street View shows the real location, not the damage.

steps.title: 2. Upload the Swiss claim
steps.detail: Recommended: schadenmeldung-geschaeftsversicherung.pdf, email-01-schadenmeldung-de.pdf, email-02-loss-estimate-en.pdf and the 6 IMG_2026…jpg photos (9 files). The .eml files are alternative original bundles with attachments; do not upload them alongside the same PDFs and photos.
steps.tip: Files are in assets/demo-prevaiq/property-claims/swiss-chocolate-storm/; manifest.json documents the synthetic data.

steps.title: 3. Watch AI processing (2-3 min)
steps.detail: German and English documents are read as they are; the analysis is shown in your UI language and applies the Swiss policy conditions (AVB KMU-Geschäftsversicherung 2026). In Evidence, open Swiss SME business AVB to preview the matching PDF; French home and health conditions are not offered. Amounts and the expertise threshold remain in CHF.

steps.title: 4. Fraud analysis, Web IQ and provenance
steps.detail:
Run the fraud analysis:
• Web IQ searches in German, region CH ("Unwetter Winterthur 28. August 2026 Hagel Sturm"), without a Cat-Nat query
• Expected points: building items also reported to the GVZ, refrigerated goods without the Kühlgut extension, a photo dated 26.08 (before the storm)
• Each photo shows its Content Credentials (C2PA) badge, for information only
steps.tip: Synthetic images; JPEG copies have no C2PA data. Awning retracted before the storm; oblique wind-driven hail, retained cracks in safety glazing, no punched-out holes. Hail covers exposed street areas, not just one spot. Local water tracks come from frame joints, not solid glass. Chocolate stays in closed showcases, packaging and lidded kitchen equipment. The dry cold room shows 23.8 °C after power restoration, not proof of spoilage or full stock loss. Amounts are provisional; technical reports, inventory and temperature records are not attached.

steps.title: 5. Select DE-CH and ask IQ
steps.detail:
Switch the interface to DE-CH (German, Switzerland). Ask IQ answers in Swiss Standard German, not dialect; source quotations remain unchanged. Ask:
→ "Ist das Kühlgut versichert?"
→ "Welcher Selbstbehalt gilt für Elementarschäden?"
→ "Wer deckt den Gebäudeschaden im Kanton Zürich?"
steps.tip: Answers cite the Swiss AVB articles (CH-AVB-…).

steps.title: 6. Adjuster decision
steps.detail: Ex: "Stock, equipment and business interruption covered per AVB B2 and C; building items referred to the GVZ (B1.3); refrigerated goods excluded without the extension (B4.1); Elementar deductible 10%, max. CHF 50,000."

habitation-ch-watch.label: Property Claims (CH · Watches)
habitation-ch-watch.summary:
Rheinkaliber Uhrenmanufaktur AG (fictitious) — Schaffhausen windstorm, 28/08/2026 — Haute horlogerie workshop, clean room and machines damaged — CHF 14,968,600 claimed
German claim form and cost estimate, German and English e-mails, 10 AI photos (MAI-Image-2.6). A consistent large-loss scenario: no planted fraud or coverage anomaly.

steps.title: 1. Select "Property Claims"
steps.detail: Use the property claims persona. The documents identify Switzerland, Schaffhausen and CHF; this is a commercial contents and business interruption claim, not a French Cat-Nat case.
steps.tip: Real demo map anchor: Mühlentalstrasse 185, 8200 Schaffhausen. The business, premises and loss are fictional; AI photos do not depict the actual building or occupants. Street View shows the real location, not the damage. No real watch brand is used.

steps.title: 2. Upload the watch manufacture claim
steps.detail: Recommended selection: schadenmeldung-geschaeftsversicherung.pdf, kostenvoranschlag-schadenbehebung.pdf, email-01-schadenmeldung-de.pdf, email-02-loss-estimate-en.pdf and the 10 IMG_2026…jpg photos (14 files). The two .eml files are alternative original email bundles with embedded attachments, not additional files to include with this selection.
steps.tip: Files: assets/demo-prevaiq/property-claims/swiss-watch-storm/. manifest.json lists the photos, amounts and expected outcome. Any promotional wristwatch concept is separate and must not be uploaded as damage evidence.

steps.title: 3. Follow extraction and coverage analysis
steps.detail: Check the German and English documents against the Swiss AVB KMU-Geschäftsversicherung 2026. Movements and finished watches are claimed at manufacturing cost, not retail value. The sum insured exceeds the declared insurable value. In Evidence, preview Swiss SME business AVB, not French conditions; recommendation amounts and the expertise threshold use CHF.
steps.tip: The matching policy is assets/pdf/prevaiq/prevaiq-ch-avb-kmu-geschaeftsversicherung-2026.pdf; index it before testing policy-grounded answers.

steps.title: 4. Check consistency, Web IQ and provenance
steps.detail: Run the fraud analysis and verify the storm against Swiss public sources for Schaffhausen on 28 August 2026. All ten photo scenario times follow the storm; later photos show mitigation, inventory and the adjuster's visit. Building repairs and emergency roof cover are handled by the GVSH, not included in this claim.
steps.tip: Expected: no planted inconsistency. Photos show samples, not the full inventory or internal watch damage. Request inventory records, technical reports and valuation evidence; these are not attached. Images are synthetic; JPEG copies have no C2PA credentials. The net amount remains an estimate subject to adjuster validation.

steps.title: 5. Ask IQ about the large loss
steps.detail:
Ask:
→ "Why are the watches valued at manufacturing cost?"
→ "Is there underinsurance?"
→ "Who covers the building damage in Schaffhausen?"
→ "What is the net claim after the Elementar deductible?"
steps.tip: Expected calculation: CHF 14,968,600 less CHF 50,000 = CHF 14,918,600. Ask for the relevant AVB citations.

steps.title: 6. Record the adjuster decision
steps.detail: Expected demo decision, subject to the adjuster's validation: contents, equipment, clean-up and business interruption covered under the Swiss AVB; building excluded from this demand and referred to GVSH; capped Elementar deductible CHF 50,000; net CHF 14,918,600. A high amount alone is not a fraud indicator.
